notes.title: Patch Notes 1.10
notes.content: [p]We have released patch 1.10 for [i]RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army[/i]. Additionally, accompanying this update, we would like to share a message from the game's Producer/Director, Yamai Kazuyuki.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558630/fc5bee167906c384a15da7ea4743ff0b43d1f218.png"][/img][/p][p]Please see the details of the fixes included:[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]1) QOL Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]MAG can now be collected through gun attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “Hold” input option for Weak Sword Attacks and Strong Sword Attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Button/key assigned to safeguarding demon allies is now remappable.[/p][/*][*][p]Demon allies will no longer waste MAG by using skills unnecessarily once battle ends.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added “Retry battle on another difficulty” option when Raidou is defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell demonic materials at Konnou-ya.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now travel directly to Konnou-ya through Dragon Founts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ON/OFF toggles for the next objective UI, destination icons, and applicable investigation skills so players can enjoy the atmosphere of the original game.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced carry-over elements for New Game+.[/p][list][*][p][u]Totality[/u][/p][p]Raidou's level, stats, money, Devil Chart, and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over. Summoner Skills, swords forged through Sword Alchemy, and items will also be carried over, with some exceptions.[/p][/*][*][p][u]Luxuries[/u][/p][p]Raidou's money, Devil Chart, and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over. Summoner Skills, swords forged through Sword Alchemy, and items will also be carried over, with some exceptions.[/p][/*][*][p][u]Basics[/u][/p][p]Raidou's Devil Chart and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Balance adjustments for the following battles:[/p][list][*][p]Episode 1: Gashadokuro[/p][/*][*][p]Episode 1: Ichimokuren[/p][/*][*][p]Episode 8: Mishaguji[/p][/*][*][p]Final Episode battles[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Devil Chart now displays demon registration completion rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ON/OFF toggle for shortening demon fusion animations.[/p][/*][*][p]After demon fusion, the game will no longer return to the fusion top menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened animation when reforging a sword that has already been crafted in Sword Alchemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced downtime after summoning a demon ally in the field.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to skip the greeting animation during demon reports.[/p][/*][*][p]Even when Raidou’s title is manually selected, the rank-up animation will play when a new title is unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]When completing a case file, the name of the completed quest will now be shown in the completion animation (to avoid confusion about which quest was cleared).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of Gouto saying “Use your gun.”[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]2) Other[/b][/p][p]Various bug fixes.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army[/i]![/p]

notes.title: RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army (PS5) Review
notes.content:
RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army is not only a mouthful to say out loud, but it’s also a remaster packed with meaningful quality-of-life improvements, enhanced gameplay mechanics and an overall level of polish that elevates it beyond a simple remake of a classic Shin Megami Tensei spinoff originally released on the PlayStation 2.

Set in the Taishō era, RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army explores one of the more intriguing periods in Japan’s history—a time when the country began to feel the influence of Western culture and democratic ideals. That setting alone is compelling, but the addition of classic Shin Megami Tensei demons makes for an action RPG fans shouldn’t miss.

Furthermore, unlike previous remaster efforts from Atlus, RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army goes above and beyond the typical remaster route, providing a slew of new assets—such as improved demon character models, which appear to be touched-up and... Read more

[*] [i]“Raidou Remastered seems like it will be a promising remaster from Atlus, as well as an opportunity to introduce a larger audience to an interesting Shin Megami Tensei game.”[/i] – [b]Siliconera[/b], [url=https://www.siliconera.com/preview-raidou-remastered-offers-a-more-active-smt-experience/]Preview: Raidou Remastered Offers a More Active SMT Experience[/url]

[*] [i]“But what I’m really happy about is that the visual upgrade still holds some of the grunginess of the original PS2 game.”[/i] – [b]Inverse[/b], [url=https://www.inverse.com/gaming/raidou-remastered-preview]Raidou Remastered Is a Stunning Upgrade of a Seminal PS2 Game [/url]

notes.title: Announcing RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army!
notes.content:
Hello Raidou fans, 

We're pleased to announce [b]RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army[/b]! Unleash the supernatural in a thrilling detective adventure set in a fantastical era of 1930s Tokyo. Play the action JRPG remaster in a brand-new way with revamped visuals, QOL changes, an overhauled battle system, and much more! 

Check out the announcement trailer: 

[previewyoutube=wrbHRMm0txM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Return of Raidou Kuzunoha | World Spotlight [/h2]

Want to dive deeper into the world of Raidou? Watch "The Return of Raidou Kuzunoha | World Spotlight", a special spotlight video now live on our YouTube channel. This 22-minute showcase details the game's setting, enhancements from the original version, as well as an interview with Director Kazuyuki Yamai. 

[previewyoutube=lIr3mDfEAlo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Submit A Player Title To Add In-Game! [/h2]

We are giving all of you an opportunity to contribute a title to potentially be added into the game! Head over to our social media channels to participate, where you can submit a title suggestion using the hashtag #RaidouTitle.
